# T16 — Change control (retrospective, 2026-11-23)

## Change requests

| Change | Title | Status |
|---|---|---|
| CHG-T16-1 | Accept the T16 deliverables with their evidence | approved |

The six deliverables are complete against the frozen scope baseline. The change authorises
recording their acceptance and evidence on the WBS rows, which the baseline gate otherwise
refuses.

## Impact

- Scope: WBS deliverables 1–6 — status accepted, evidence refs, no scope change.
- Baseline: the frozen scope baseline is unchanged and remains the reference.
- Schedule and cost: no change; this is the retrospective record of delivered scope, not new work.

## Decisions

- Approved by the distinct approver `01a1e8a7-8b23-76a9-9114-aafb95f7a545` under the programme's
  published standing delegation, recorded on the change row's `meta.approved_by`.
- The approved change is the authority the WBS acceptance reads.

## Deliverables accepted under this change

| # | Deliverable | Business value | Time criticality | Risk reduction | Job size | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | SOP intake as a governed asset: procedures.ingest_sop produces capability and job drafts | 9 | 8 | 6 | 3 | accepted |
| 2 | RDF/OWL/Turtle imported as a strata knowledge pack bound by knowledge_pack_ref | 8 | 7 | 5 | 2 | accepted |
| 3 | BPMN, Visio and draw.io converted into PDDL procedure drafts | 9 | 8 | 6 | 3 | accepted |
| 4 | Source review and human publication gates: the drafting job cannot publish its own procedure | 9 | 7 | 7 | 2 | accepted |
| 5 | Re-ingest versioning keeps the published row's source and pack | 8 | 6 | 6 | 2 | accepted |
| 6 | A bound job runs the PDDL steps; an unreviewed source never binds | 8 | 7 | 6 | 2 | accepted |
